description: The broadcasters (platform, region, link) of a bout or of a whole card, with the card start time in UTC. Give bout_id or event_id. An empty list means none is on record yet. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

name: where_to_watch

as_of.description: ISO UTC time of this answer

cite.description: the markdown link to quote with any fact of this answer: Source: [Boxerbook](<url of the main page>)

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

start_utc.description: ISO UTC start of the card, when known

title: Where to watch
